project.description: The counterpart to scenario 63 on the other side of the boundary: deduplication has to hold between an application bean's injection point and the test class's own, not just between two beans. It did not, because the two collection paths keyed a plain @Inject differently - ProcessInjectionPoint reports CDI's normalized set, in which an undeclared qualifier is @Default, while the test class's fields are walked reflectively and yielded the empty set, so the same unqualified type registered two @Default beans and the deployment failed with AmbiguousResolutionException on OpenWebBeans and WELD-001409 on Weld. Issue 155 normalized the reflective walk to @Default; this scenario asserts the shared instance that follows, and would fail again the moment the two paths disagree.
project.name: jawelte tests/cdi-module scenario 64: one auto-mock is shared by an application bean and the test class
